items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We have a mutual friend who lives in Pennsylvania. We were on the phone. He was telling me Bill is getting Alzheimer’s, unfortunately.

ctx.x: He had a superlative record, known for a sound, that CTI sound.
Which I feel that Bill should have respected.
Right. Well, he was young. Maybe it was the ignorance of youth.
